fusions.name: Draw the Dregs
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target. The tines draw it out for 8 damage, using it up and adding half its remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Returned Dose
fusions.desc: Sweeps the tines round you, dealing 26 damage that ignores resistances to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, 10% more for each affliction already on it, up to 40%. Each is left [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Comb Out the Bitterness
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 poison conditions from you and restores 8 health.

fusions.name: Residue Reclaimed
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions on an enemy runs out, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
